<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Docking Bay 327''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：ドッキングベイ３２７</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに行くには、１フォース必要。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに行くには、１フォース必要。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-124o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Docking Bay 327.

'''Light Side:''' Travel from here to another docking bay costs 1 Force.

'''Dark Side:''' Travel from here to another docking bay costs 1 Force.

The photograph matches the artwork and 1 Force text on both halves of the original English Light Side printing. The collector holder labels this copy Dark Side.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese is going to another docking bay; English is your docking bay transit.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
